steps.speaker: Mira
steps.text: I need your help with something!

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.text: I've added a new quest to your journal. Go collect some herbs and bring them back.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.text: Check your quest tracker to see your progress.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.text: You found the herbs! Let me mark that off.

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.text: And you returned to me. Excellent work!

steps.speaker: Mira
steps.text: Here are 100 gold and 50 EXP for your trouble!
